== Biography ==
Rose was born in 1847. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1050|Andrew Glasgow]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1050]] is assessed at 71% (probable). The 1851 Ballycregagh household places Rose aged four with widow Elizabeth and grandson Samuel in the McCullow family. This coheres with Samuel's Andrew father hypothesis but names no father for Rose.

Selected Glasgow-1050 fatherhood of Glasgow-4072; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Seek Elizabeth McCullow's marriage and Rose's baptism.
